fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami as a "playground" city, including debates over tolerance toward racing, gambling, drinking, and nightlife; criticism of chain grocery practices and calls to patronize local merchants; discussion of real estate prices and promotion of lower-priced lots; and a column on Jackson Memorial Hospital budget cuts and the use of an efficiency expert. Additional local notes cover traffic and parking conditions, sidewalks and street improvements, airport needs, political items, and social/entertainment listings and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach venues.
